column1: # The version behind each benchmark column: model <TAB> version <TAB> recorded <TAB> note.
# design/0016 §2 requires versions on record, because grok moved 4.5 -> 4.6 in
# the middle of this project and no result file said so. This table is the
# record: `xenith-bench run` stamps the matching `version` into every result
# file it writes, as `model_version`, and `summarize` prints the table.
# Hand-maintained on purpose — see the reader's header comment in
# src/main.rs for why a `--version` probe cannot replace it. The values below
# were probed once (2026-08-13) and cross-read against invoke.ps1, which is
# where the pinned model ids actually live: change a `--model` flag there and
# this table is stale until someone updates it.
# The rule: whoever runs a campaign burst updates the row **before** the
# burst. `xenith-bench verify` fails if a column is missing or blank, so a
# forgotten row cannot reach CI green. A version that genuinely cannot be
# pinned to one model says so in words (`auto-router`) — a fact, not a blank.
codex
column4: `codex exec` names no model; the CLI default answers and does not self-report which.

column1: grok
column4: The 4.5 -> 4.6 move that motivated design/0016 §2. Cells measured before it are not comparable.
